title: Department Payroll
description:
Report each department's name and its total salary bill. A department with no employees (or only NULL salaries) must report `0`, not NULL.

Name the columns `department` and `payroll`. Return the result in any order.
schemaSql:
CREATE TABLE departments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  location TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE employees (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT,
  title TEXT,
  salary INTEGER,
  dept_id INTEGER,
  manager_id INTEGER,
  hire_date TEXT
);
solutionSql:
SELECT d.name AS department, COALESCE(SUM(e.salary), 0) AS payroll
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.dept_id = d.id
GROUP BY d.id, d.name;
hint: SUM over no rows is NULL, not 0. Wrap it in COALESCE or IFNULL.
outputExplanation: Engineering's total payroll is $485,000, Sales is $285,000, and HR is $60,000.
